problems.issue: Relying solely on a social media profile instead of a dedicated business website.
problems.impact: Limits brand credibility, search engine visibility, and control over customer data and user experience.

problems.issue: Profile restricted by login wall or lacking public indexing (redirects to login/canonical login).
problems.impact: Potential customers without a Facebook account cannot view business information, services, or contact details.

opportunities: Develop a fully responsive, dedicated business website with local SEO optimization.
Integrate clear calls-to-action (CTAs) for lead generation and direct customer inquiries.
Implement structured data (Schema.org) to improve search engine presence and local map listings.
audit.summary: The business currently utilizes a Facebook profile as its primary web presence, which severely restricts public visibility due to login barriers and lacks the professionalism and functionality of a dedicated website.

outreach.subject: Quick thought on Lumina Dental Clinic's online presence
outreach.body:
Hi there,

I was looking into Lumina Dental Clinic this morning and noticed you're currently using a Facebook profile as your main online hub. 

Because Facebook requires a login to view much of its content, potential patients without an account are hitting a wall when trying to check your hours, services, or contact info. It also means you miss out on Google search traffic from people looking for local dental care.

We put together a quick, clean draft of what a dedicated website could look like for Lumina—giving you total ownership and making it effortless for new patients to find you.

Would it be useful if I sent the live demo over?

During the first visit, we informed her that root canal treatment was a possible treatment option; however, the root canal procedure itself was not scheduled to be performed during that appointment. At the same time, we ask for the same consideration for our doctors, staff, and other patients, whose appointments are also scheduled in advance and arrive on time.

We remain committed to providing our patients with professional care, clear communication, and proper appointment management. As previously communicated, we also fulfilled our commitment to process your request for the refund and provide the requested radiographs.

We respect every patient's right to share their experience and provide feedback. We only hope that the circumstances are presented accurately and in their proper context.

problems.issue: Heavy reliance on JavaScript-rendered content via Wix framework, which may delay initial page rendering and impact Core Web Vitals if not properly optimized.
problems.impact: Potential drop in search engine ranking and user frustration due to slower load times on mobile devices.

problems.issue: Lack of server-side rendered (SSR) meta tags and structured data visible in the truncated HTML payload for local dental SEO optimization.
problems.impact: Reduced visibility in local search results (Google Maps/Local Pack), missing out on high-intent nearby patients.

opportunities: Implement LocalBusiness schema markup to enhance Google Maps and local search snippet visibility.
Add prominent call-to-action (CTA) elements such as online booking or click-to-call buttons above the fold to improve patient conversion rates.
Ensure image assets served via static.wixstatic.com utilize modern formats like WebP or AVIF with responsive sizing for faster mobile loading.
audit.summary: The website is built on Wix and effectively loads necessary polyscripts, but lacks visible SEO optimizations and performance structures in the initial HTML document. Focusing on local schema markup, conversion rate optimization, and speed will drive more appointment bookings.
